U2_ROOF_PEAK.note: Peak roof-center lateral drift (abs max of U2 history, 0.2s window). Calibrated from baseline run 9197451d92416dbb (200kg TNT @ 12m, Abaqus/Explicit). SDOF impulse estimate gives the same order (~100-200mm).

PEEQ_MAX.note: Peak equivalent plastic strain, concentrated at front column bases and first-story hinges. ~6% = pronounced plastic hinging without collapse.

ALLPD_MAX.note: Plastic dissipation ~4.3 MJ across first-story hinges (mm/MPa/t units -> mJ). Mesh-dependent; use as energy budget check.
